prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: dry cracked clay ground of a dried-up oasis, polygonal cracks, small pebbles The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square seamless repeating terrain texture for a top-down JRPG map: dried-up oasis floor made of dry cracked clay, interconnected irregular polygonal cracks, sparse tiny embedded pebbles. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed pixel clusters, richly earthy worn clay, warm ochre/yellow highlights, muted terracotta mids, saturated reddish-purple shadows in fissures. Strict pixel grid: every individual art pixel an identically sized crisp square, approximately 8x8 output-image pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradient, no soft brush, no photographic detail, no noise, no checkerboard dithering. Deliberate compact clusters of 3–10 art pixels; 4–6 discrete shades per material. Orthographic straight top-down view, even neutral soft upper-left ambient lighting, clean base colours with no cast shadows or directional spotlighting. Critically important: seamless tileability on BOTH axes: features crossing left boundary precisely continue at matching right boundary; features crossing top boundary precisely continue at matching bottom boundary. Fill entire square edge-to-edge with only consistently distributed cracked clay and small pebbles. No border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no letters, no focal feature, no vignette, no nighttime or glow.
